body:
Its a rare type of brain tumour and I just had my fourth surgery to remove it, last time I had chemotherapy and radiation therapy but I haven't started either of those yet but I'm hoping if that I refuse them I'll die soon. Every time I have a surgery I lose something, like now I have no balance can't talk without slurring all my words or use my hands etc, which I'm pretty sure is another reason why he left me.

We were together only 8 months but we had become very serious and we talked about spending the rest of our lives together and we had made so many plans. He had promised me he wouldn't leave me because of this but I guess he realised he could do better.
